requirements.requirement: The system must render a board certification section within the provider scorecard inside MessageBubble when certification data is present.
The system must display a certification status badge (e.g., Certified, Not Certified) based on normalized logic output.
The system must visually differentiate certification status using distinct badge styles for positive vs negative states.
The system must render the issuing body text exactly as provided by the normalized logic layer.
The system must display the certification’s contribution to the overall score in a human-readable format (e.g., +X points or included in score).
The system must position the board certification section consistently within the provider scorecard layout in MessageBubble.
The system must ensure the certification section does not break or overflow the MessageBubble layout across supported screen sizes.
The system must render all certification elements (badge, issuing body, score contribution) within a single cohesive UI block.
The system must not render the board certification section if certification data is null or undefined.
The system must display a fallback label (e.g., "Certification data unavailable") when certification data is present but incomplete.
The system must handle unknown or unexpected certification status values by rendering a neutral badge state.
The system must ensure rendering logic consumes only the defined schema from EVAL-P-BOARD-UX-S1 without direct raw backend field access.
The system must render the certification section within the existing MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline without introducing a parallel rendering path.
The system must ensure that the certification UI does not block or delay rendering of other scorecard elements.
The system must render text content (issuing body and score contribution) in a readable font size and contrast consistent with existing MessageBubble styles.
